turns.customer: My order #1055 is really late. Can I at least get my shipping cost back?
turns.reply:
Done — your **$7.99 shipping refund** has been issued to your original payment method.

For what it's worth, the delay is a carrier-side weather and volume backlog in Salt Lake City, so there's nothing on your end holding it up. Once Parcelway gets it moving again, the tracking in your account will update as it goes.

Thanks for your patience, and I hope the stove makes a good first use soon.
